stem: A dental team plans care for a child with a sensory impairment such as deafness or blindness. Which approach is most appropriate?

options.text: Use the same communication style and clinic environment as for every other patient.
Treat the impairment as irrelevant to the delivery of dental care.
Defer all care because the impairment makes treatment impossible.
Use alternative communication, an adapted environment, and an individualized approach.
